inviteNew.subject: Invitation to “{tenant}” in FG To-Do-Manager
inviteNew.body:
You have been invited to the tenant “{tenant}” in FG To-Do-Manager.

Use the following link to set your password and complete your registration:
{link}

The link is valid for {days} days and can only be used once.

inviteExisting.subject: Invitation to “{tenant}” in FG To-Do-Manager
inviteExisting.body:
You have additionally been invited to the tenant “{tenant}” in FG To-Do-Manager.

Use the following link to accept the invitation with your existing login:
{link}

The link is valid for {days} days and can only be used once.

passwordReset.subject: Reset password – FG To-Do-Manager
passwordReset.body:
A password reset was requested for your account.

Use the following link to set a new password:
{link}

The link is valid for 1 hour. If you did not request this, you can ignore this e-mail.
